sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes frame-level applicability, supporting-structure attachment relationships, conditional longitudinal and transverse requirements, two-sided web connection, bracket properties, and the millimetre thickness comparison with the correct direction.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent evidence-free passes. For every in-area frame, require at least one hasFrameAttachment and at least one identified supporting structure via an alternative path over hasSupportingWebFrame/hasSupportingBulkhead; retain the per-support shared-attachment/effective-confirmation query. Apply the same support-presence requirement to the longitudinal branch so an in-area longitudinal frame cannot satisfy the bracket obligation with no listed supports. Also make bracketThickness and the attached frameWebThickness single-valued (maxCount 1) before comparing them; the current unrestricted multiplicity makes the operand pairing ambiguous.

Scope the bracket constraints to frames within the ice-strengthened area: remove sh:targetClass from the helper ConnectionBracketShape and do not apply FrameBracketRequirements unconditionally before the applicability sh:or. Invoke these helpers only from the true applicability branches, so out-of-area frames and unrelated brackets are not constrained. Also factor the all-frame effective-attachment and pass-through requirements into an untargeted reusable in-area frame shape and apply it explicitly to frame, longitudinalFrame, and transverseFrame focus nodes; otherwise subtype-only instances can evade those general obligations when superclass targeting is not available.

Candidate faithfully encodes frame-level applicability, supporting-structure attachment relationships, conditional longitudinal and transverse requirements, two-sided web connection, bracket properties, and the millimetre thickness comparison with the correct direction.
